source.title: Everolimus improves neuropsychiatric symptoms in a patient with tuberous sclerosis carrying a novel TSC2 mutation.

confirmation.summary: MRI findings consistent with TSC and a novel small TSC2 deletion on whole-exome sequencing.
evidence: We performed whole exome sequencing and identified a novel small deletion mutation in TSC2
cortical tubers and subependymal nodules consistent with TSC

note.text: Our son had his first long seizure with a fever at 13 months, and a second one at 17 months lasted more than an hour. After that he had frequent seizures, with or without fever, and was often admitted to hospital. He has several pale patches on his chest, belly and back. He is far behind other children in using his hands, talking and getting along with people, and he does not interact with us the way other children do.
note.author: Peter's Kiro, written from the article's findings; not the parent's words
